Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1328
Claimant:
Caleb Johns
Adjuster:
Christopher Wong
06/30/2024
First notice of loss received for a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. The insured reports that the vehicle
was stopped at a red light when it was struck from behind.
07/07/2024
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates coverage.
08/15/2024
Police report obtained. Responding officer confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene and records the
collision as described by both drivers.
08/22/2024
Statements taken from two independent witnesses. Both describe the impact the same way as the insured and say
the other vehicle was moving too fast to stop.
10/03/2024
Scene and vehicle photographs reviewed. The rear damage is largely consitsent with the impact described, and no
prior damage to the vehicle is known from the records available.
10/09/2024
Other driver interviewed and does not dispute the sequence of events or the point of impact.
10/15/2024
Claimant is represented by counsel. Initial medical report lists a wrist fracture, which is a typical injury for this type
and force of impact, and there is no known prior injury to that area.
10/31/2024
Claimant's account was revisited in a recorded follow-up. Some small details were added, but the core sequence of
events has stayed the same across every statement.
11/05/2024
Treatment records reviewed. Care followed a usual course, with activity restrictions and therapy easing as the
claimant's condition improved.
11/27/2024
Medical file shows steady recovery and a tapering off of treatment visits. Counsel has been copied on all updates
requested for the bodily injury evaluation.
11/28/2024
File reviewed and assessed as consistent across the police report, witness statements, photographs, vehicle damage
and medical records. Claim moving to bodily injury evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
